$comment: Tokens that check-token-consumers.mjs would otherwise flag, with the argument for why
they are fine. The reason string is the point of this file: 'no stylesheet in this repo
reads it' is a fact, but whether that is a defect or a downstream contract is a judgement
the checker cannot make from inside this checkout, so it has to be written down by a human.
The overwhelmingly common legitimate reason is uids_base: UIDS owns the vocabulary, and
SiteNow's theme is the consumer. Those tokens ship as CSS custom properties in dist/ and
are read by Drupal-side SCSS that is not in this repo. Cite the class or file that reads
it, so the claim can be checked against /Users/bspeare/acquia/uiowa rather than believed.
An exemption is INHERITED by everything the token aliases to, so list the semantic token
rather than the primitive underneath it.
This file is deliberately short. The checker's other warnings are a to-do list, not a
backlog to silence — resist adding an entry to make a run quieter.

allowed.--uiowa-space-110: uids_base only: the layout--onecol--fixed condensed-band padding (1.1rem top/bottom), a band deliberately outside the section rhythm — see contracts/layout.json geometryNotTokenized.onecol-fixed-padding. No UIDS component uses this step. Legacy, flagged for 5.x consolidation in its own token comment.
allowed.--uiowa-layout-block-stack-default: uids_base only: default sibling-block top spacing inside Layout Builder regions (1.6rem). The stacking rhythm it drives is a Drupal region behavior with no UIDS equivalent — nothing in src/scss stacks sibling blocks. Covers the space/160 primitive beneath it, whose only parent this is.
